newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks sag towards end on blue chips.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks sag towards end on blue chips.

text.p: Pakistani stocks dipped towards the end on Wednesday as blue-chip Hub Power fell on selling pressure, but dealers said overall trading was dull.

"Hub Power tumbled as its Global Depositary Receipt (GDR) rates fell abroad," dealer Sajjad Mankani said. "But overall trading remained dull as major players kept to sidelines. The bomb explosion in Karachi also dampened sentiment."

The Karachi 100-share index fell 9.97 points, or 0.67 percent, to end at 1,474.21. Gainers led losers 132 to 112. Hub Power fell 0.50 rupees to 34.50 and Adamjee Insurance 3.50 to 98. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
